author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಇತಿಹಾಸವರಿಯದವ ಭವಿತವ್ಯ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸನು
ಮಿತಿಮೀರಿ ವರ್ತಿಸುತ ಗುರಿಯ ಮರೆಯುವನು
ಮತಿಯಿಂದ ಗತಿಯರಿತು ಯೋಜಿಸಿರೆ ನಡೆನುಡಿಯ
ಗತ ತೇಜ ಮರಳುವುದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: One who does not know history cannot build the future;
crossing every limit, he forgets his goal;
but read the course of things with wisdom, and plan your words and deeds —
and the glory that was lost will return, O deluded one.
en.note: The Kannada plays on mati (wisdom) and gati (course, direction).
en.bhavartha: Those who do not learn from the past cannot shape the future; they overreach and lose their way. Understand how things came to be, plan your words and deeds with care, and lost greatness can return.
